name: secure-software
description: Adversarial, evidence-driven security engineering for software and infrastructure.

interface.longDescription: Threat-model, audit, reverse, validate, and harden websites, APIs, services, desktop and mobile apps, cloud and IAM, CI/CD, containers, operating systems, dependencies, and deployed software. The workflow prioritizes reachable attack chains, explicit evidence, realistic impact, and root-boundary remediation.
defaultPrompt: Threat-model this repository and trace the highest-impact attack paths.
Run a deep security audit and validate findings from entry point to impact.
Fix the validated finding at the narrowest shared trust boundary.
